causes.description: Tracking bug: signup events from Safari 19.3 stopped being recorded from 2026-03-03; the accounts were still created in billing (signups happened, analytics lost them).
Price increase in IN (India): pro price shown rose [('2026-01', '8'), ('2026-02', '8'), ('2026-03', '12')]; real IN signups fell ~32% vs the trend in other countries.
Residual / noise: small across-the-board dip within normal variation.

not_causes.description: paid_social decline is seasonal: Mar vs Feb was -33% in 2025 too, offset by organic_search; total signups were flat Feb->Mar 2025 (-1.1%).
